subject: Close acceleration: champion stitch & final evaluation rally
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Wright <alex.wright@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Close acceleration: champion stitch & final evaluation rally

Alex —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I pulled together a short mutual action plan (MAP) that focuses on the two things that will get us to contract signature before year-end: 1) exec sponsor alignment / EB availability and 2) a compressed evaluation runbook for key P0 workloads. Attached is a working MAP (Aurelia_MAP_v3.xlsx) and a proposed Executive Briefing (EB) cadence (EB_proposed_slots.ics).

High-level asks:
- Can you confirm the exec sponsor (C-level) who will join the EB? We recommend a 45-minute slot with the VP Eng + CFO or procurement rep in attendance.
- We suggest a 2-week eval sprint focusing on inference latency and cost-per-inference on your production-ish dataset. Can Aurelia provision a 100GB sample dataset and one infra contact for the run?
- Procurement: please flag any non-standard terms up front so we can route to Contracts quickly.

Plan next steps (proposal):
1) Confirm sponsor and procurement attendee by Tue 10/12.
2) Redwood runs the eval (2 weeks) starting 10/17; daily checkpoints Mon/Wed.
3) EB with execs the week of 10/24 to review results + pricing.

I cc'ed Marissa (CS lead for close) and Priyom (AE) so we can map owners in the MAP and lock EB slots.

Attachments: Aurelia_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP draft), EB_proposed_slots.ics

Best,
David Kim
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Wright <alex.wright@aureliahealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@aureliahealth.com
Date: 2027-10-11T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Close acceleration: champion stitch & final evaluation rally

David —

Appreciate the clear plan and the artifacts. A few quick notes from my side:

- Exec sponsor: I can be the technical exec sponsor for the EB, but I need our CFO (Lydia Park) or a procurement delegate on the call for commercial sign-off. I copied procurement.
- Data: we can provide a 120GB anonymized batch that mirrors peak-hour traffic. IT will stand up S3 access (I’ll share an infra contact tomorrow).
- Timeline: the 2-week sprint works, but procurement is likely to require a final review window for standard security clauses and a sub-committee sign-off. Can we build a short procurement checklist into the MAP?

Also: one ask from my legal team — can Redwood share your standard data retention and deletion commitments for private deployments (SOC2 details would help).

If we can lock the EB for Tue 10/25 11:00am PT that would be best for my schedule.

Thanks —
Alex Wright
VP, Engineering
Aurelia Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Alex Wright <alex.wright@aureliahealth.com>
Date: 2027-10-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Close acceleration: champion stitch & final evaluation rally

Looping in a slightly more operational MAP and procurement checklist — included a short section that maps owners, deliverables, and dates.

Key updates I made to the MAP:
- Added procurement checklist (Procurement_Checklist_Aurelia.pdf) with the items they flagged as common blockers: KMS/HSM, data residency, liability caps, and third-party subprocessor list.
- Added an EB agenda: 10 mins exec intro, 15 mins results + demo, 10 mins pricing options, 10 mins next steps & approvals.
- Proposed EB participants: Alex (VP Eng), Lydia Park (CFO) or procurement delegate, David (Redwood Sales Sponsor), Marissa (CS), Priyom (AE), and a short tech panel (runtime lead).

Can Priyom please draft the commercial proposal to run alongside the EB (two price bands: Reserved capacity + Private deployment options)? I’ll ping Contracts for a fast-track review and get back on SOC2 artifact availability.

Thanks —
Marissa
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>

Alex —

Thanks for confirming sponsor and the data path. Quick logistics and commitments from our side:

- Evaluation runbook: Redwood will run the 2-week eval starting Mon 10/17. Daily checkpoints at 10:30am PT (Mon/Wed) — internal leads only; weekly summary for Aurelia every Friday.
- EB: locking Tue 10/25 11:00am PT (invitation attached). Please confirm Lydia or an approved procurement rep can join — procurement signoff is required to process a DocuSign for the reserved capacity commit.
- Commercial: attached link is a draft SOW + two-tier pricing (Reserved / Private). If procurement signs the checklist items, we can move to DocuSign immediately after EB.

DocuSign envelope (draft): https://docusign.example.com/envelope/ABC123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/3421

Attachments: Procurement_Checklist_Aurelia.pdf, Aurelia_MAP_v3.xlsx

Looking to Marissa to confirm Contracts owner; David will steward exec invite.

Best,
